executive_summary: Fernglow Digital has submitted an exceptionally strong, comprehensive proposal that directly and thoroughly addresses every single requirement and constraint set forth by NordFrame Logistics. The solution fully embraces the existing PostgreSQL database without proposing unnecessary migrations, includes role-based access control enforced at the database query level, provides automated low-stock alerts, outlines a clear timeline matching both the 3-month pilot and 6-month full rollout milestones, and stays well within the €80,000–€120,000 budget envelope at €102,000 total.
strengths: Directly addresses the requirement for PostgreSQL integration via a read-only connector without schema changes or data migration.
Implements role-based access control securely at the database query level rather than just hiding UI elements.
Proposes a clear, phased rollout plan starting with a 1-warehouse pilot within 10 weeks (under the 3-month target) and full rollout within 24 weeks.
Provides transparent pricing of €102,000, perfectly fitting within the client's €80,000–€120,000 budget range while including Year 1 support.
Includes a thoughtful Risk & Assumptions section acknowledging database read access requirements, point-of-contact dependencies, and tuning periods.
weaknesses_and_gaps: Support SLAs define critical issues as system down with a 24-hour response time, which could be tightened to 4 hours for mission-critical inventory operations.
Minor ambiguity regarding the specific SMS gateway provider used for low-stock alerts, though standard email/SMS is noted.

scorecard.evaluation_notes: Offers a continuous real-time web dashboard across all 6 regional warehouses.
Connects directly to the existing PostgreSQL database via a read-only connector with zero schema changes or migrations required.
Enforces strict warehouse-level isolation for managers and company-wide visibility for HQ at the database query level.
Includes configurable per-item thresholds with automated email/SMS notifications.
Outlines a comprehensive pilot (10 weeks) and phased rollout (Weeks 13-24) with parallel run validation.
Clearly defines support terms including 24-hour response for critical issues and 3-business-day response for minor issues during CET hours.

scorecard.requirement_title: Documentation of Assumptions, Limitations, and Risks
scorecard.evaluation_notes: Provides transparent documentation covering database schema assumptions, POC dependencies, and threshold fine-tuning.
